entities.name: Lady Edara
entities.description: Beautiful lady of the island state of Jehesic in the Dark Age of Terisiare.

entities.name: Jehesic
entities.description: Fortified island state ruled by Edara.

entities.name: Lord Peemel of Iwset
entities.description: Lord who longed to claim Jehesic, proposed to Edara and kidnapped her.

entities.name: Ferantia
entities.description: Traitorous sorceress who betrayed Edara and was stabbed by Apepei.

entities.name: Apepei
entities.description: Dwarf, Edara's secret lover who killed Ferantia and Digody.

entities.name: Ihesia
entities.description: Peemel's general-in-chief taken prisoner by Jehesic.

entities.name: Digody
entities.description: Peemel's advisor who stabbed him; slain by Apepei.

entities.name: Yunnie
entities.description: Son of Peemel's late wife who shattered the Sigil and left Iwset.

events.summary: Edara repeatedly turned down Peemel's marriage proposal.
events.quote: he proposed a marriage, which she repeatedly turned down

events.summary: Ferantia betrayed Edara openly but was stabbed to death by Apepei.
events.quote: she was stabbed to death by Edara's secret lover, the dwarf Apepei

events.summary: Peemel kidnapped Edara to trade for his captured general Ihesia.
events.quote: Edara was kidnapped by Lord Peemel

events.summary: Digody stabbed Peemel in the back, and Apepei slew Digody.
Yunnie refused marriage to Edara, shattering the Sigil and leaving Iwset; Edara and Apepei began their combined rule.
events.quote: Yunnie refused this, shattering the Sigil and leaving Iwset
